ABOUT THE PRACTICE

A dental studio built
around your smile.

Dr Mothupi Dental Studio is a patient-focused dental practice located in Pretoria North, created to make essential dental care feel approachable, comfortable and professional.

VISION

To create a dental practice where ethical principle, clinical excellence, and compassionate service set the standard of the clinic. To empower patients to achieve optimal oral health and improved quality of life.

MISSION

To enhance the smile and improve oral function by providing exceptional dental care
